description: This PHP class defines a decorator for managing leave entitlement entities within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates operations such as calculating available leave days, checking if a date falls within the entitlement period, and setting related entities like leave type and employee via reference. The class uses traits for common functionality and interacts with various entity classes.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the LeaveEntitlement entity providing additional utility methods for handling leave entitlement data, such as calculating available days, checking date periods, and setting related entities.

methods.name: getAvailableDays
methods.description: Calculates the number of leave days available by subtracting days used from the total number of days.

methods.name: withinPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setEntitlementTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave entitlement type reference based on an ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an employee entity with the leave entitlement based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave type reference based on an ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave entitlement formatted as a string.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave entitlement formatted as a string.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the credited date of leave entitlement formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Checks if the leave entitlement can be deleted using external service.
